question: Sudha Chandran is a known actress and an accomplished _____ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sudha Chandran is an Indian actress who appears in Indian films and Television shows.

 
 
• She is an accomplished Bharatanatyam dancer. 
 
• In 1981, she hurt her leg in a road accident near Tiruchirapalli, Tamil Nadu while coming back from Madras with her parents.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Dance form**
 **Dancers**
 
 

 Kathakali
 Kalamandalam Gopi, Kalamandalam Krishna Prasad, Kottakal Sivaraman, Kalamandalam Ramankutty Nair, Kalamandalam Vasu Pisharody, Kavungal Chathunni Panicker.
 
 

 Kuchipudi
 Raja and Radha Reddy, Yamini Reddy, Kaushalya Reddy; Bhavana Reddy, Lakshmi Narayan Shastri and Swapana Sundari
